```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)

data("ny_noaa")

ny_noaa_78 = ny_noaa |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  separate(
    date, 
    into= c("year", "month", "day"), 
    sep="-", 
    remove=TRUE
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    month = as.numeric(month),
    day = as.numeric(day),
    year = as.numeric(year),
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax),
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin)
  ) |> 
  filter(
    year == 2007 | year == 2008, 
    day == 1)
```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Chart A

```{r}
ny_noaa_78 |> 
  group_by(year, month) |> 
  summarize(
    mean_prcp = mean(prcp, na.rm=TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    year = as.factor(year),
    month = factor(month.abb[month], levels = month.abb)
  ) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~month, 
    y = ~mean_prcp, 
    color = ~year, 
    type = "bar", 
    colors = "viridis"
  ) |> 
  layout(
    title = "Average Precipitation by Month: 2007 vs. 2008",
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Mean Precipitation (tenths of mm)"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Year"))
  )
```

Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Chart B

```{r}
ny_noaa_78 |> 
  filter(
    year == 2007, 
    !is.na(prcp)
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    year = as.factor(year),
    month = factor(month.abb[month], levels = month.abb)
  ) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~month, 
    y = ~prcp, 
    type = "box", 
    colors = "viridis"
  ) |> 
  layout(
    title = "Precipitation Distribution by Month in 2007",
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Precipitation (tenths of mm)")
  )
```

### Chart C

```{r}
ny_noaa_78 |> 
  filter(
    !is.na(snow), 
    !is.na(tmax), 
    !is.na(tmin)
  ) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~tmin, 
    y = ~tmax, 
    color = ~snow,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    colors = "viridis",
    alpha = 1
  ) |> 
  layout(
    title = "Temperature association with Snowfall in 2007",
    xaxis = list(title = "Min Temp"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Max Temp"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Snowfall"))
  )
```
